Subject: J-4130 - RAMS approved for residents' rooms

Dear Kerry,

Thank you for the risk assessment and method statement for the redecoration of residents' rooms (your job J-4130). It is approved, with two conditions:

1. Low-odour, water-based paints only in occupied areas.
2. No more than two rooms out of use at any time, and all work between 9.30am and 4pm.

Please report to reception on arrival each day.

Kind regards,
Joy Adeyemi
Home Manager, Saltings Lodge
